Column_1: Pre-Kindergarten (Pre-K) – Includes Baby Nursery (BN) and Nursery (N).
Kindergarten (K) – Commonly referred to as the foundation stage in the Maldives. It includes Lower Kindergarten (LKG) and Upper Kindergarten (UKG).
Key Stage 1 (KS1) – Includes education levels Grades 1 to 3.
Key Stage 2 (KS2) – Includes education levels Grades 4 to 6.
Key Stage 3 (KS3) – Includes education levels Grades 7 to 8.
Key Stage 4 (KS4) – Includes education levels Grades 9 to 10.
Key Stage 5 (KS5) – Includes education levels Grades 11 to 12
